answer.thought: The air is thick with the dust of the city and the silence of the house. My body complains of the void in the stomach, a physical negation that mirrors the bureaucratic void of my file. I shall sit in the shade and let the afternoon pass, for to move without purpose in such heat is merely to exhaust the spirit.
